objective: Integrate a bounded Michigan tranche of official USGS Breeding Bird Survey positive standard-run Stop 1 detections as sampled point recorded-presence evidence, with exact taxon matching, committed route-start geography receipts, and no negative inference from source silence.

selection.method: A fresh full retained-input replay after the Montana integration left Michigan, Oregon, and Wyoming tied at 39 net-new pairs; deterministic state-code ordering selected Michigan.

inputs.scienceBaseReleaseTitle: 2026 Release - North American Breeding Bird Survey Dataset (1966 - 2025)

transportRepair.trigger: The first Michigan acquisition invocation received four response headers and then aborted while consuming a successful response body after 319.361 seconds. No immutable run directory or evidence event was accepted.
transportRepair.rootCause: Response body consumption occurred after the adapter's retry try/catch, so an AbortSignal timeout raised during response.arrayBuffer escaped the bounded retry loop.
transportRepair.scope: Idempotent GET response-body handling only. No candidate, source identity, taxon, geography, review, or evidence semantics changed.
transportRepair.implementation: Move successful response body consumption inside the existing retry try/catch, preserve the three-attempt and three-minute limits, retain oversized-payload rejection outside transport retry, add a two-body-timeout success fixture, and register adapter version 1.1.4.
verification: Focused fixture proves success after two response-body timeout errors.
Existing HTTP 502, thrown network error, exhaustion, source identity, evidence semantics, and geography fixtures pass.
Immutable-run validation and TypeScript checks pass.

cutoffBoundary.reason: The immutable run began after 2026-08-29T23:59:59.999Z. The projection uses the run's truthful UTC date rather than backdating the evidence.

checks.requestedPairConservation: pass: 39 planned equals 39 accepted plus 0 rejected
checks.netUniqueMovement: pass: all 39 pairs moved from implicit not researched to verified present
checks.negativeSemantics: pass: zero verified-absence, not-detected, or researched-unresolved movement
checks.taxonMatching: pass: exact current-catalog binomial plus exact retained BBS AOU mapping
checks.geographyReceipts: pass: every assertion retains a positive coordinate count, coordinate-set SHA-256, and committed active-county topology identity
checks.sourceDrift: pass: release identity, citation, four file byte counts, and four MD5 checksums matched the committed plan
checks.adapterContract: pass: focused USGS BBS header retry, body retry, timeout, semantics, and exhaustion tests
checks.sourceCoverage: pass: 1,428 current hash-reconciled entries across 29 sources
checks.projectionByteStability: pass: two independent Michigan compiles were byte-identical across 89 files with protected shared outputs unchanged
checks.publication: pending all-state, integrity, type, lint, build, manifest, cadence, storage, and production launch gates

remainingBoundaries: This run supports sampled point recorded presence only and does not claim countywide inventory, establishment, absence, or survey non-detection.
Michigan remains a research-only bounded tranche and is not certified.
The jurisdiction evidence registry remains empty pending required human approval for any exact negative assertions.
R2 ordinary promotion cadence remains closed until 2026-09-04T08:58:25.633Z.
The application and data release decisions remain owned by the production launch gate.
nextAction: Commit the deterministic Michigan projection and this evaluation, regenerate the cumulative publication manifest and readiness dashboard, run the full local release gates, then enter the formal production launch gate.
